On-Time Shipment

On-Time Shipment

We are committed to deliver your package of sartorial joy at your doorstep on time, at the correct address. 

For orders within India, we deliver in 5 to 6 business days for delivery. For international orders, we deliver in 10 to 12 business days. Wedding couture requires extra time for handcrafted details and fittings, thus we take 30 or more business days to create your curated couture piece. Place your order well in advance to ensure timely arrival.

Custom Sizing Available

Custom Sizing Available

We offer a wide range of size options to tailor your every fit to sheer perfection. We have a special video guide for you on every ensemble to help you measure and select custom sizes. You can share your measurements in a detailed form that help us stitch your desired outfit with utmost precision.

Frequently Asked Questions

What makes Riyaasat the best ethnic wear online store?

Riyaasat is considered one of the best online stores for ethnic wear because of its premium quality fabrics, modern designs, and traditional craftsmanship. As a trusted ethnic wear online store, we offer stylish outfits for weddings, festivals, and special occasions.
Is Riyaasat an Indian ethnic wear online store?

Yes, Riyaasat is a leading Indian ethnic wear online store that celebrates traditional Indian fashion with a modern touch. Our collections are inspired by Indian culture, fabrics, and craftsmanship.
What options do you have for women’s ethnic wear?

As a premium ethnic wear store online, Riyaasat offers:

  • Sarees
  • Lehengas
  • Indo-western outfits 
  • Bridal Trousseau
  • Salwar Suits
  • And Festive wear drops for special occasions 

Our collection caters to varied tastes and preferences of contemporary women rooted in tradition. 

What types of ethnic wear are available at Riyaasat?

As a premium ethnic wear store online, Riyaasat offers:

  • Kurta sets 
  • Jacket kurta sets - 
  • Indo-western outfits 
  • Wedding and Festive wears

Our collection caters to different occasions and style preferences.
Does Riyaasat deliver across India?

Yes, as a nationwide ethnic wear online store, Riyaasat delivers across India, from major cities to small towns.
Can I find wedding outfits at Riyaasat?

Absolutely. Riyaasat offers a premium range of wedding and festive outfits, making it a reliable Indian ethnic wear online store for grooms and wedding guests.
How do I choose the right ethnic outfit online?

When shopping from an ethnic wear online store, consider the occasion, fabric, fit, and style. Riyaasat provides detailed product descriptions to help you make the right choice.
Can I return or exchange if the size I selected is not fitting me?

Yes, for ready-to-ship items you can exchange or return after informing our Customer Care within 48 hours has to update us in case of exchange/returns with photo or video attached either on Whatsapp or at info@riyaasat.in. Upon approval, we’ll initiate the exchange/return process within 7 days.
Can I get a refund upon returning the item?

The refund varies from case-to-case basis. For instance, if size of the product is the issue, we recommend you try exchanging first. If the item is defective or sabotaged during the delivery, we take responsibility and offer a Credit Note to the customer and ensure their next shopping experience with us is smooth-sailing. However, we initiate refunds only in extreme cases considering the nature of the products.
